justifications.type_expressiveness: Distinct error variants capture every failure mode (OutOfRange carries the offending value, InvalidCharacter carries the char), with no stringly-typed data and a clean enum-based domain model.
justifications.error_handling: Typed enum with meaningfully distinct variants, no unwrap/panic in library code, and the sole unreachable! is genuinely unreachable given the prior character validation.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Narrow public surface, full doc comments on every public item, sensible derives (Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq), and a Display impl with informative messages.
justifications.idiomaticity: Idiomatic use of matches!, ?, checked_add, iterator-driven encoding via a const table, and re-encoding for canonicality is a clean Rust pattern.
